title: Empty delivery queue
summary: Set the starting queue count correctly so a delivery loop skips work when no deliveries are waiting.
statement: A delivery system uses count to track parcels waiting to be processed. This run starts with an empty queue, so the loop should process no parcels and print Done. Update the starting count while keeping the existing loop and output code. Before running, predict count at the first while check.

specification.input: There is no standard input. The number of waiting parcels is set by the count initializer in the starter code.
specification.output: Print exactly Done followed by a newline. Because the queue is empty, the loop body must not execute.
specification.constraints:
Change only the starting value in int count = 1; so it represents an empty queue.
Keep the while condition and loop body unchanged.
Do not change the output statement.
Submit a single-file C++17 program.

checkpoints.question: How many parcels are waiting at the first while check?
